subject: MAP: Security review & SOC 2 package (Aurelia Tech)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.coole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Baker <tom.baker@aurelia-tech.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Security review & SOC 2 package (Aurelia Tech)

Tom / Lara - great to meet today. Quick recap and next steps (attached MAP draft). Please review and confirm the milestones below so we can lock a target close date.

Summary of today's discovery:
- Primary use: customer-facing LLM endpoints for search & summarization.
- Data classification: PII in user prompts (PII is redacted/stored per customer config).
- Compliance needs: SOC 2 Type II evidence + contract clauses for data retention and access logging.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
1) Security review kickoff (your security + our security) - action: confirm scope & questionnaire answers - target 2026-05-12 - owner: Aurelia Tech (confirm) / Redwood (provide questionnaire).
2) SOC 2 package delivery (evidence index & artifacts) - target 2026-05-15 - owner: Redwood (deliver) / Aurelia Tech (review).
3) Contract negotiation & procurement - target 2026-05-22 - owner: Aurelia Tech procurement / Redwood legal.
4) Final technical validation (canary traffic + perf validation) - target 2026-06-01 - owner: Redwood infra / Aurelia SRE.
5) Target close / go-live: 2026-06-25 - owner: both.

Dependencies / open items:
- We will need the SOC 2 questionnaire answered and a short list of artifacts we can share (evidence index).
- Procurement contact + PO cadence to finalize billing.

Attached: MAP draft (doc), SOC2 questionnaire (blank) - I can push the completed questionnaire and evidence index once we confirm scope.

Ask: can you confirm Aurelia's procurement contact and whether the 2026-06-25 target close looks feasible?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.coole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: Aurelia-Tech-SOC2-Questionnaire.pdf (stub), MAP-draft-AureliaTech.docx (stub)

From: Tom Baker <tom.baker@aurelia-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.coole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lara Chen <lara.chen@aurelia-tech.com>, procurement <procurement@aurelia-tech.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Security review & SOC 2 package (Aurelia Tech)

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- For the SOC 2 package, we primarily need: the completed questionnaire, evidence index (mapping of controls to artifacts), system architecture diagram showing network boundaries, and a short summary of your logging/retention practices. Is that a standard package you can provide?
- Can you share a redlineable MAP doc so our legal can propose minor language edits (SLA / data retention)?
- Procurement contact is procurement@aurelia-tech.com (copied). We typically need invoices 30 days net; would like to understand billing cadence if we go to Dedicated.

Also - small ask on timeline: our security team is out for a week starting 2026-05-11. If we can get the questionnaire before then we can at least review answers internally and flag any gaps.

Tom - thanks for the quick response and the procurement contact. We can absolutely get you the SOC 2 materials before 2026-05-11. Attached you'll find:
- Aurelia-Tech-SOC2-Questionnaire.pdf (filled with guidance notes where applicable)
- redwood_soc2_evidence_index.xlsx (mapping controls to artifacts we can share)

Proposed updated milestones (based on your note):
- 2026-05-12: Security review kickoff / questionnaire Q&A - owner: both (Aurelia security + Redwood security).
- 2026-05-15: Redwood delivers full evidence index & artifact links (owner: Redwood - Aditya will coordinate).
- 2026-05-22: Contract redlines returned (owner: Aurelia legal / procurement).
- 2026-06-01: Triage of any outstanding security gaps + final validation plan (owner: Redwood infra + Aurelia SRE).
- 2026-06-25: Target close / go-live.

If that works I'll mark the MAP as agreed and loop our security lead (Aditya) to deliver the artifacts.

Regards,
Marissa

Forwarding Aurelia's ask - can you please prepare the SOC 2 package and evidence artifacts for delivery? High level responsibilities:
- Aditya: compile evidence index, pull system architecture diagram, redact artifacts as needed, produce short pen-test summary. Target deliverables and dates below.
- Stephanie: review legal redlines for contract SLA/retention items (we may need legal to prep a short memo on retention options).

Requested deliverables / timeline:
- 2026-05-12: SOC2 questionnaire (finalized) - owner: Redwood / Marissa to send updated answers if any.
- 2026-05-15: Evidence index + artifact links (owner: Aditya).
- 2026-05-20: Redacted artifacts + pen-test summary (owner: Aditya) - ready for sharing with Aurelia under NDA.

Notes: Aurelia's security team is out 2026-05-11 through 2026-05-18, but they asked for the questionnaire before they leave so they can pre-review. Please confirm if these dates are feasible.

Thanks - looping you both to ensure we hit procurement / security milestones.

Marissa
